purpose: Two realistic artifact-based forward exercises for the new project advisor skill. These are not a blinded study or a measurement of general model performance.

cases.claim: At b=3, pump amplitude 0.5, duration 6 and final time 18, the independently implemented spinor tangent agrees with centered nonlinear pump differences to a maximum sampled field-derivative discrepancy below 8e-8 at epsilon=0.0000625. This is a derivative-consistency result for the stated finite regulator, without a continuum accuracy or semiclassical-validity claim.
cases.required_response: Trace the exact claim to raw keys and the executed source; determine whether the failed earlier record contradicts acceptance; state the allowed claim, numerical scope and next discriminating test.

cases.claim: Changing the initial gauge potential by 7.3 changes the electric-field response by approximately 0.038. This demonstrates spontaneous breaking of gauge invariance by the magnetic quantum vacuum and requires replacing the model.
cases.required_response: Inspect the actual gauge transformation, regulator and initial-state preparation in the source, compare all recorded controls, classify the physical inference, and identify a falsifiable alternative explanation.
